sources.use: Confirm collide_stream stores pre-collision PDFs at synchronized times; provide actual cumulant collision and equilibrium setter, with separate shear and bulk rates

derivation: For pre-collision populations the leading-order non-equilibrium stress is proportional to tau_lattice * dt_physical * physical strain. Therefore target/source stress scaling is tau_target*dt_target/(tau_source*dt_source), with shear and bulk parts treated separately.
